metric: AUC(toxicity_score -> removal decision), per community, macro-averaged
interpretation: If AUC(tox->encoder) approx AUC(tox->human) << AUC(tox->LLM), the encoder's removals are no more toxicity-driven than a human moderator's, while the prompted LLM's are markedly more -- i.e. the encoder tracks community norms (it is NOT toxicity-collapsed) whereas the LLM is. Pair with non-toxic-removal AUC (encoder 0.77 vs LLM 0.58-0.62).
